# Seminars I've given (since 2006)

[YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL12D676032C3A6B70){.badge .badge-large}

Some of these seminars were given more than once, but to avoid repetition, repeats are not always listed.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const heading = document.querySelector("h1");
  const listing = document.getElementById("listing-listing");
  const filterBox = listing ? listing.querySelector(".listing-actions-group") : null;
  if (heading && filterBox) {
    heading.classList.add("listing-heading-row");
    heading.appendChild(filterBox);
  }

  // Make the whole row clickable, navigating to that seminar's page
  const tbody = listing ? listing.querySelector("tbody.list") : null;
  if (tbody) {
    tbody.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      if (e.target.closest("a")) return;
      const row = e.target.closest("tr");
      const link = row ? row.querySelector("a.listing-title") : null;
      if (link) {
        window.location.href = link.href;
      }
    });
  }
});
</script>
